userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-button-group>` element implements the <tp-icon name="button-group" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Button group functionality: aPI documentation summary.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | This component organizes or presents content. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated keyboard action. |
| Embedded controls, when present | Use their normal keyboard interactions. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
